children: The 10-year Treasury yield jumped 0.185 percentage point this week to a level not seen since 2007.
It was the fourth consecutive week of yield increases for the benchmark 10-year Treasury and its 10th weekly increase over the past 13 weeks, according to Dow Jones Market Data.

The 2-year Treasury yield has an even longer weekly streak going. It ended the week 0.121 percentage point higher than it started. That represents the sixth straight week of increases. During that period, the yield has risen 0.692 percentage point, the sharpest move in more than three years.
